warnings.warning: The Poisson expression states N>0 and omits the zero-arrival mass.
The cell/time discretization is coarse and has no refinement evidence.
The source calls f a frictional force while setting a 0.7 coefficient and linearly approximating Gs.
The displayed ad radical is not transparently derived from ap and V1=V0-4.
Gs changes from 10+2.8V to 10+3.4V after an uncalibrated simplification.
D is described as an average over vehicles, but Eq.15 displays only the event sum.
The A=3 right-pass weight rests on an uncited qualitative assertion.
The appendix output line is visibly truncated and helper functions are omitted.
Code metric extraction does not fully reconcile velocity, density, passing, and danger units.
The three speed-limit cases are local sensitivity, not global uncertainty robustness.
Intelligent safety is collapsed to speed by assuming crashes absent except breakdown.
The 0.1 s response time and modified tables are not calibrated.
The joint speed-safety recommendation lacks a calibrated utility bridge.
The source appendix closes without a complete executable archive.

main_argument_chains.claim: Keep-right and unrestricted rules produce conditional efficiency and safety differences.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Compare rules by lane count and inflow rather than declaring a universal winner.

main_argument_chains.claim: A conditional intelligent-system switch can combine the two rule regimes.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Use keep-right below the tested threshold and unrestricted above it, with source-specific caveats.

main_argument_chains.claim: Traffic-rule recommendations require explicit model and data limitations.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Treat numerical conclusions as bounded simulation evidence and prioritize calibration/reproduction extensions.
